raw:
The 2016 British Grand Prix was won by Lewis Hamilton (Mercedes). It was round 10 of the 2016 season, held at Silverstone on 10 July 2016. Max Verstappen finished second and Nico Rosberg third.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
